_README: Style loadings for surface derivation (briefing CCB-S4-005 section 4.2).
DATA, NOT CODE, and VERSIONED. Editable without a rebuild; the loader refuses a set
without a version. Same pattern and same reason as archetypes.json: values derived
from these weights are properties of a specific weight set, so anything measured
against them must be able to name which set it was measured against.
EVERY FIELD IS A WEIGHT VECTOR OVER THE SIX LATENT TRAITS, including
sentenceComplexity, whose specification direction is 'verbosity up, C up'. Verbosity
is itself a linear combination of latent traits, so substituting it keeps
sentenceComplexity linear in the latent vector, which is what makes the analytic
normalisation valid. Expressing it as a function of an already-derived field would
have required a second normalisation with no closed form.
THE SPECIFICATION GIVES DIRECTIONS, NOT NUMBERS. The directions are:
tone                E up, C down, A up        (formal to casual)
verbosity           E up, C up
warmth              A up, E up
humor               E up, O up, C down
emojiAffinity       E up, A up, C down
sentenceComplexity  verbosity up, C up
The magnitudes below are authored within those directions. They are NOT read off any
data and there is no claim that they are.
AUTHORED WITH THE COLLINEARITY DIAGNOSTIC RUNNING. tone, warmth and humor all load
on extraversion and agreeableness, so they will correlate no matter what; that is
INTENDED structure. What is not intended is two fields becoming near-duplicates when
their loadings share little. verify:surface reports the correlation across derived
fields and, for each pair, whether the correlation is explained by shared loadings or
is an artefact. That distinction is what made the archetype diagnostic useful (D-097)
and it applies unchanged here.
REACTION SCORES are pre-softmax. Directions from the specification: A and E push the
warm and celebratory reactions; C and low E push the acknowledging ones; low A is what
enables thumbs-down at all.
TEMPERATURE sharpens the reaction softmax before the floor is applied. At 1.0 the
scores produce a distribution so flat that almost every avatar retains almost every
reaction, which is the failure section 6 names: a distribution where every avatar has
some probability of every reaction expresses no personality at all.
TONE AND EMOJI AFFINITY WERE RE-AUTHORED after the section 8 diagnostic caught them
correlating at 0.983 on its first run. The specification gives both fields the same
three traits in the same directions (E up, C down, A up), so near-duplication is
inherent unless the MAGNITUDES differentiate them. Formality is mostly a
conscientiousness property; expressiveness is mostly extraversion and agreeableness.
The coherence cap was inert at 0 of 20,000 avatars before this, because two fields
that correlate at 0.983 can never disagree enough for a coherence rule to have
anything to do.
